verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never documents a Browserbase feature that extracts fields using CSS or XPath selector rules. The closest items are natural-language selectors in the SDK (docs-5), generic browser control (docs-4), and URL-to-HTML/JSON/markdown conversion (docs-3). These are adjacent features or developer building blocks, not declarative CSS/XPath field extraction.

support.subject: As a developer, I can extract specific fields from a page using CSS or XPath selector rules
